channel.title: Worcester Business Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Allurion faces potential NYSE delisting, plans to appeal decision
item.description: In response, Allurion says it will appeal the NYSE’s decision, stating the company has been in regular contact with the stock exchange regarding its plan to regain compliance.

item.title: 🔒 Complaint alleges Chip Norton embezzled $1M+ from Southbridge hotel
item.description: The complaint seeks to block Norton from discharging all debt related to the Chapter 7 filing, potentially leaving him on the hook for about $76 million in debt so far claimed by various creditors. Through his attorney, Norton denied the allegations.

item.title: Judges appear skeptical of municipal challenge to MBTA housing law
item.description: As judges hear Marshfield's arguments, Holden is the lone non-compliant municipality in Central Massachusetts.

item.title: StartUp Week Worcester returns as collegiate pitch competition adds two new schools
item.description: StartUp Week Worcester will feature an innovation crawl featuring prominent local companies, as well as six workshops and the annual WooTank Intercollegiate Pitch Competition.

item.title: The Shops at Blackstone Valley to expand with two new buildings
item.description: The buildings will house 10 retailers, restaurants, and wellness providers at 70 Worcester-Providence Turnpike.

item.title: 🔒 Jabil to shutter Clinton facility after 60% companywide workforce reduction
item.description: Jabil is closing operations at its Clinton facility this year, marking the end to what has been decades of significant employment in the region.

item.title: 🔒 Whole Foods plaza in Shrewsbury listed for sale
item.description: Lakeway Commons, a 90,035-square-foot shopping plaza in Shrewsbury anchored by a Whole Foods Market, has been listed for sale. The plaza, built in 2018 at the former site of the […]

item.title: Ameresco generated $2B in revenue, $44M in profits in 2025
item.description: Looking ahead to 2026, the company expects revenue to continue upward, projecting 9% growth.

item.title: Hudson commercial landscaper acquired by NY firm
item.description: Unisource will become the Boston MetroWest branch of the New York-based firm.

item.title: Sterling plastics dealer fined $23K for hazardous waste violations
item.description: A Sterling dealer of plastic manufacturing equipment has been fined $23,000 by the Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection
